body.label: Trigger
body.html: Your Locked target willingly moves more than 2 units or uses an Action that exposes it from cover.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Make a ranged attack against the triggering creature. On a success, deal 1 weapon damage and it burns 1 die on its next Action this turn.

surges.html: One affected enemy suffers -1 Defense until its next turn.
One affected enemy burns 1 die on its next Action.
